transfer.title: Confirm the request to take over this home's service?
transfer.description:
«{company}» has asked Hauflo support to hand this home's service over to it.

If you own this home and asked for it, choose «Yes»: your confirmation is attached to the request. Nothing changes now: Hauflo support decides after telling the previous company (usually in 14 days). If the request is granted, «{company}» gets the home's setup in Hauflo and becomes the contact on the alarm cards; the previous company loses access.

Didn't ask for it? Choose «No».

independent.title: Make the house independent
independent.description:
What happens:
- The Hauflo dashboard cards are copied to /config/www/hauflo and added as dashboard resources, so the family's dashboard works without the agent.
- Every enabled Hauflo alarm rule becomes an ordinary automation in automations.yaml: the same sensors and alarm states, a push to the same Home Assistant app phones (critical where the rule is), a notification in HA and the rule's button. A backup copy of automations.yaml is made first. Automations made earlier this way are left as they are.
- Nothing is deleted. Hauflo keeps working until you remove the integration; until then an alarm comes twice.

What stops working once Hauflo is removed:
- Cloud monitoring: «agent offline», «KNX bus silent», the monitoring page and the service company's view.
- E-mail alarms and the alarm history in Hauflo; repeats until «Accept».
- Deploys and updates from the project, guest links, «Away» presence simulation, the comfort floor, voice sentences, editing the family's automations and scenes on the dashboard (the ones already made keep running).

Submit to do it.

link_lost.title: No link to Hauflo for {hours} hours
link_lost.description: This Home Assistant has not reached Hauflo ({server}) for {hours} hours. The house works as before, but monitoring, alarms to Telegram and deploys from Hauflo wait for the link. Check the internet connection of this Home Assistant; the agent reconnects by itself. This message goes away when the link is back.

unlinked.title: Hauflo no longer knows this Home Assistant
unlinked.description: The project was unlinked or deleted in Hauflo, so the agent stopped connecting. To link it again, get a new code in Hauflo (project → «Connect the home» → «Get a code») and enter it in Settings → Devices & services → Hauflo → Re-configure. If you don't use Hauflo any more, delete the integration.
